messages:
tasha: Kickoff: Gateway + LangChain/LlamaIndex + orchestration pilot. Want to align on scope: connector, sample app, marketplace listing, and a joint demo. Tentative timeline: 6 weeks. Anyone from eng/product can join weekly sync?

mike: I can take the connector build and perf validation. Need sample data shapes and target latency SLOs.

levi: I'll prep a devex quickstart + SDK examples (JS + Python). Want to make onboarding <15 min.

amy: Product: we'll define success metrics — 1) end-to-end sample working 2) marketplace listing ready 3) partner co-demo scheduled. Can we sketch the user flows?

olivia: Olivia from BridgeWorks (SI) — happy to collaborate on the sample integration and customer scenario. We have an insurer pilot that maps well.

raj: Legal: keep me in the loop for marketplace terms and any co-marketing IP clauses. We'll need partner MSA + asset approvals.

sara: Marketing: we'll draft a joint announcement and a webinar. Can we target a demo for the summit in ~8 weeks? Will need hero screenshots and an explainer video. :calendar:

mike: For SLOs: aiming for median latency <= 120ms for gen calls under dedicated capacity. We'll profile during alpha and share numbers.

tasha: High-level scope: 1) LangChain connector + LlamaIndex adapter 2) Gateway manifest + Helm chart for customers 3) One sample orchestration using our runner and partner gateway 4) Marketplace listing + docs + co-marketing.

levi: Sample README outline I'll use: feature list, quickstart, troubleshooting, FAQ. Also add automated smoke tests that run on PRs.

mike: Quick question: do we force function-calling compatibility or just standard chat/streaming?

amy: Product: start with chat + streaming + structured outputs. Function-calling can be v2 if time allows.

olivia: For the SI scenario, function-calling matters for action orchestration. If it's not in MVP, we can stub it.

tasha: Action items: 
- mike: connector + perf (owner)
- levi: quickstart + smoke tests (owner)
- olivia: sample customer scenario & dataset (owner)
- amy: define success metrics + demo flow (owner)
- sara: comms plan + partner webinar (owner)
- raj: contracts checklist (owner)
I'll send a calendar invite for weekly sync.

mike: Also need a small compatibility manifest for the gateway. I'll paste a draft here: 
```yaml
name: redwood-gateway-bridgework-connector
version: 0.1.0
compatibility:
  - langchain: >=0.0.200
  - llamaintex: >=0.5.0
  - runtime: dedicated-v2
routes:
  - path: /v1/gateway
    methods: [POST]
```

levi: Nice. I'll add that to the quickstart and include a curl example and a tiny sample repo.

tasha: Timeline check: Week 0-1 design & contract signoff, Week 2-4 build + alpha, Week 5 smoke + docs, Week 6 partner review + demo. Does that feel doable?

olivia: Yes from our side, we can commit 1 engineer for weeks 2-4.

raj: Legal: will circulate a partner MSA template by EOD Friday.

sara: I'll draft a 1-pager and sample social copy draft by next Wed.

mike: One more: can infra provision a small dedicated pool for perf tests? @deploy-bot any chance?

deploy-bot: @mike — test pool request received. ETA provisioning: 48 hours. See https://redwood.internal/infra/req/2468

tasha: Cool. I'll create a public tracker and populate initial tasks after this thread. Thanks all — weekly sync invite in 30m. :thumbsup:
